title: nardophyllum bryoides
intro: Nardophyllum bryoides, commonly known as Mountain Rose, is a species of flowering plant in the family Asteraceae. It is known for its potential health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Nardophyllum bryoides include its ability to soothe and calm the body, making it useful for stress relief and anxiety. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
